name: Koko
source:
Koko is a manakravter in [url=/c45469]Melano's[/url] party, who personally led the assault on Rughzenhaide.

Koko often appears to overindulge in confidence during a battle, belittling her quarry before striking the fatal blow.

[Edited from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sekaiproject/fault-milestone-one-directors-cut/description?lang=es]Fault's Kickstarter[/url]]
